title: Sword Saint: Broken Bridge
pitch: A mirror match on a bridge in a storm. Two fighters share one seven-move kit, so the match is won on timing and meter, not character choice.
description: Case study: Sword Saint: Broken Bridge, a solo fighting-game design project in Ikemen GO covering two fighters, a shared moveset, defensive systems and a storm stage.
contribution: Designed a shared seven-move kit with a timed perfect block, a stamina system and a meter-gated super, plus the six-layer Broken Bridge stage.
facts: Solo designer: characters, moveset, combat systems and stage
Ikemen GO · Fighter Factory Studio · Notepad++
Design project · no public build yet

cover.alt: Two identical stick-figure swordsmen with red headbands face each other on a wooden rope bridge under a dark blue sky, with health and meter bars at the top.
cover.caption: Work-in-progress capture on Broken Bridge. The HUD still shows placeholder “testChar” names.

quick.label: The game
quick.text: A one-on-one fighter. The Sword Saint faces Unknown, a mirror fighter on the same moveset, on a storm-lit bridge.

quick.label: My part
quick.text: All of the design: both characters, the seven-move kit, block, perfect block, stamina, and the Broken Bridge stage.

quick.label: Evidence
quick.text: In-engine capture, stage art and the character sprite sheet below. No public build, tuning values or playtest notes yet.

sections.title: Seven moves, shared by both fighters.
sections.intro: The Sword Saint and Unknown use the same moveset. Unknown is a mirror fighter, so every tool one player has, the other has too.

sections.title: Blocking with a timing layer.
items: Holding block is the safe default.
A block timed to the incoming attack counts as a perfect block, separate from simply holding block. It rewards timing, not just holding the button.
A stamina system sits alongside the kit.
sections.gap: Tuning values, frame data and playtest notes for these systems aren't documented yet.

sections.intro: A six-layer storm stage with animated lightning and rain. The fight takes place on the bridge deck, with the storm behind it.
